title: Senior Backend Engineer, Payments
content: <p>Example Co is growing its payments team in Portugal. You will build and run the Rust services that settle our customers&#39; payments.</p><ul><li>Five years of backend work</li><li>Postgres in production</li></ul>

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Platform
content: <p>This role is fully remote, anywhere in Europe. You will build the platform our product teams ship on, in Rust and Postgres.</p>
